title: Retracted records leave the pool
hook: Two stated cases: explore the usable-data denominator after invalid data are removed.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the usable-data denominator after invalid data are removed affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines RemainingMean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the usable-data denominator after invalid data are removed in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
